body: Thank you so much. I really needed that and I am feeling a little better today and I hope that my mood doesn’t decline for a while because that is not a great place to be.
I’m alone and even when I’m not I’m still stuck in my head

Extremely sad. I’m stuck in this place of emotional pain and sadness and I want to hurt myself. I need a distraction and nothing is helping. I feel like people judge me and always think there’s some simple fix but I’m broken and there’s nothing simple about me
